description: Replace the old Jido Git commit with the published Jido 3.0.0-beta.1 package, align exact Action and Signal prereleases, fix only demonstrated compatibility issues, and run core and umbrella checks.

comments.text: Completed in 02c1a6c0. Core now uses exact Hex releases Jido 3.0.0-beta.1, Jido Action 3.0.0-beta.11, and Jido Signal 3.0.0-beta.4. The only compatibility change was the published Agent module constructor in one integration test and its README example. Core quality passed with 264 tests and 82.63% coverage. The full umbrella quality suite passed.

title: Adopt Jido 3.0.0-beta.1 from Hex
